author: Bobby Grayson
description: git diff dacf642..wf/init touches only elixir/to_lean.exs (+81/-4) and elixir/src/task.ex (+13/-4). In to_lean.exs: Ctx gets field inits: %{}; the entry function adds one line 'inits = for {name, body} <- mods, init = init_of(name, body), init != nil, into: %{}, ...' and sets ctx.inits; new defps init_of/2, init_params/2, child_state/6 are inserted after collect_mods and before effects_in?/1; the only hunk in sends/3 is the spawn case replacing 'init = state_expr(e, arg, cctor, cfields)' with 'init = child_state(c, e, child, arg, cctor, cfields)'. Conflicts with other branches editing sends/3 (crash, receive, sysprops) are confined to that one line and the Ctx defstruct line. Other agents' Worker.init must stay in a supported shape (single clause, {:ok, e}, only trap_exit flags) or the translator now fails with a clear message where it used to ignore init entirely.
title: Merge note for wf/init: only sends/3 spawn case, ToLean entry (inits collection), Ctx struct, and header comment change; render_clauses, clauses, plain_body untouched; identity-init sources (supervisor.ex, watchdog.ex) translate unchanged
